name: Diameter / Proper Ordered Sample Compression (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For $\mathcal T_n=\{\emptyset,[n]\}$, $\mathrm D(\mathcal T_n)=n$ and $\operatorname{OSC}_{\mathrm{proper}}(\mathcal T_n)=1$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, $\operatorname{OSC}_{\mathrm{proper}}(\mathcal S_n)=n-1$ and $\mathrm D(\mathcal S_n)=2$.
proof: The canonical value calculations give unbounded gaps in both directions.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Diameter and Proper Ordered Sample Compression of Trivial Concepts and Singletons.
